title: Sweden Heads Toward Autumn Vote With Economy and Interest Rates Dominating… · 24 Aug
keywords: Sweden election, Riksbank, interest rates, inflation, centre-left opposition, Swedish economy, monetary policy, European Union, household finances, CPIF, Eurostat, rate hold, political polling, economic management
notes: Sweden's September election is shaping up as a referendum on economic management, with a centre-left opposition holding a commanding poll lead over the incumbent right-wing coalition. Meanwhile, the Riksbank has kept its policy rate unchanged at 1.75 percent, warning that inflation risks have not fully disappeared despite a sharp drop in headline price growth. The combination of political uncertainty and cautious monetary policy is keeping households and markets on edge.
